question: Should the experimental grouped-Claw executor land before a documented operator recovery/reconcile path and exact-head proof for external package and Gateway mutations are available?
rationale: Whether fail-closed `update_partial` plus manual inspection/replanning is an acceptable initial recovery model is a product and operations decision, not a mechanical review fix.

options.title: Require recovery proof and contract
options.body: Keep the PR open until exact-head evidence demonstrates each external boundary and a documented operator recovery path.

options.title: Accept temporary manual recovery
options.body: Explicitly accept fail-closed `update_partial` plus manual operator inspection and replanning as the initial experimental contract after reviewing the live evidence.

options.title: Split external mutation owners
options.body: Extract package and Gateway mutation from this executor until those owners have separately proven recovery semantics.

recommendation.title: Require recovery proof and contract
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until exact-head evidence demonstrates each external boundary and a documented operator recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied review comment frames the unresolved external-mutation recovery and proof decision.
